-- bre: a substitution --
s/a/b/
-- bre: global substitution with a group --
s/\(x\)/[\1]/g
-- bre: flags --
s/a/b/2gpI
-- bre: write flag --
s/a/b/w out.txt
-- bre: write flag without a file --
s/a/b/w
-- bre: unknown flag --
s/a/b/x
-- bre: repeated g --
s/a/b/gg
-- bre: zero count --
s/a/b/0
-- bre: unterminated substitution --
s/a/b
-- bre: substitution broken by a newline --
s/a/b
/
-- bre: another delimiter --
s|/usr|/opt|
-- bre: escaped delimiter --
s/\//|/g
-- bre: bracket hiding the delimiter --
s/[/]/x/
-- bre: transliteration --
y/abc/xyz/
-- bre: transliteration lengths differ --
y/abc/de/
-- bre: unterminated transliteration --
y/abc/xyz
-- bre: transliteration with flags --
y/abc/xyz/g
-- bre: append one-liner --
/x/a hello
-- bre: append without text --
/x/a
-- bre: classic insert --
1i\
first line
-- bre: change without text --
c
-- bre: block --
/x/{p;d}
-- bre: nested blocks --
/a/{/b/{p}}
-- bre: unclosed block --
/x/{p
-- bre: stray closing brace --
p}
-- bre: command after a closing brace --
{p}p
-- bre: blank and command after a closing brace --
{p} p
-- bre: comment after a closing brace --
{p}#c
-- bre: semicolon after a closing brace --
{p};p
-- bre: brace with an address --
1}
-- bre: unknown command --
k
-- bre: the removed L command --
L
-- bre: missing command --
/x/
-- bre: negation --
/^#/!s/a/b/
-- bre: double negation --
1!!p
-- bre: extra characters --
dp
-- bre: read without a file --
r
-- bre: read another file line without a file --
R
-- bre: write without a file --
w
-- bre: quit with two addresses --
1,2q
-- bre: quit with an exit code --
q5
-- bre: quit with garbage --
q x
-- bre: line zero alone --
0p
-- bre: line zero with a regex --
0,/x/p
-- bre: step --
0~4p
-- bre: relative range --
/x/,+2d
-- bre: missing second address --
1,p
-- bre: unterminated address --
/abc
-- bre: custom address delimiter --
\,foo,d
-- bre: address flags --
/x/I,/y/Mp
-- bre: branch to a label --
b end; s/a/b/; :end
-- bre: branch to a missing label --
b nowhere
-- bre: label from another expression line --
:a
N
$!ba
s/\n/ /g
-- bre: label without a name --
:
-- bre: label with an address --
1:a
-- bre: label ends at a hash --
b a#c;:a#c
-- bre: branch label ends at a blank --
b a k;:a
-- bre: colon label ends at a blank --
:a p
-- bre: colon label then unknown command --
:a k
-- bre: branch followed by a comment --
b # c
-- bre: branch with a comment after its label --
ba # c;:a
-- bre: branch label ends at a brace --
{b a};:a
-- bre: conditional branches --
:a;s/x/y/;ta;T
-- bre: comment --
# a comment
p
-- bre: exec --
e echo hi
-- bre: GNU commands --
F;z;=;l 5;Q 3
-- bre: a version --
v 4.2
-- bre: a newer sed version --
v 9.0
-- bre: a version that is not a number --
v abc
-- bre: interval --
s/a\{2,3\}/x/
-- bre: interval without a minimum --
s/a\{,2\}/x/
-- bre: interval without bounds --
s/a\{,\}/x/
-- bre: empty interval --
s/a\{\}/x/
-- bre: interval with leading zeros --
s/a\{000001\}/x/
-- bre: interval above the maximum count --
s/a\{32768\}/x/
-- bre: interval at the maximum count --
s/a\{32767\}/x/
-- bre: interval minimum above maximum --
s/a\{3,1\}/x/
-- bre: invalid interval --
s/a\{x\}/x/
-- bre: unclosed interval --
s/a\{2/x/
-- bre: leading interval --
s/\{1\}a//
-- bre: leading star --
s/*a//
-- bre: star after a caret --
s/^*a//
-- bre: star after a word anchor --
s/\<*//
-- bre: unclosed group --
s/\(a/x/
-- bre: unmatched group close --
s/a\)/x/
-- bre: literal parentheses --
s/(a)/x/
-- bre: GNU alternation --
s/a\|b/x/
-- bre: GNU plus and question --
s/a\+b\?/x/
-- bre: back-reference --
s/\(a\)\1//
-- bre: back-reference without groups --
s/\1//
-- bre: back-reference inside its group --
s/\(a\1\)//
-- bre: back-reference across alternatives --
s/\(a\)\|\1//
-- bre: back-reference past an alternation --
s/\(\(a\)\|b\)\2//
-- bre: replacement reference to a missing group --
s/\(a\)/\2/
-- bre: replacement reference without groups --
s/a/\1/
-- bre: unknown character class --
s/[[:alhpa:]]//
-- bre: character classes --
s/[[:alpha:][:digit:]]//
-- bre: equivalence class --
s/[[=a=]]//
-- bre: collating element --
s/[[.a.]]//
-- bre: a multi-character collating name --
s/[[.foo.]]//
-- bre: empty range --
s/[z-a]//
-- bre: range starting at a class --
s/[[:alpha:]-z]//
-- bre: range starting at an equivalence class --
s/[[=a=]-z]//
-- bre: range ending at a class --
s/[a-[:alpha:]]//
-- bre: a range ending at a collating element --
s/[a-[.b.]]//
-- bre: class followed by a dash --
s/[[:alpha:]-]//
-- bre: range starting at a collating element --
s/[[.a.]-z]//
-- bre: dash ranges --
s/[%--]//
-- bre: unclosed bracket --
/[abc/d
-- bre: bracket starting with a closing bracket --
s/[]a]//
-- ere: group and alternation --
s/(a|b)+/x/g
-- ere: interval --
s/a{2,3}/x/
-- ere: interval without a minimum --
s/a{,2}/x/
-- ere: interval without bounds --
s/a{,}/x/
-- ere: empty interval --
s/a{}/x/
-- ere: invalid interval --
s/a{x}/x/
-- ere: interval with a blank --
s/a{ 1}/x/
-- ere: unclosed interval --
s/a{1/x/
-- ere: lone brace --
s/a{//
-- ere: leading interval --
s/{1}//
-- ere: interval after an alternation --
s/a|{1}//
-- ere: interval after a caret --
s/^{1}//
-- ere: interval above the maximum count --
s/a{1,99999}//
-- ere: stacked intervals --
s/a{1}{2}//
-- ere: stacked quantifiers --
s/a+?*//
-- ere: closing brace alone --
s/a}//
-- ere: leading star --
s/*a//
-- ere: leading plus --
s/+a//
-- ere: star after a caret --
s/^*a//
-- ere: star after a dollar --
s/a$*//
-- ere: star after a word boundary --
s/\b*//
-- ere: question after a word end --
s/a\>?//
-- ere: star in a group after a caret --
s/(^*)//
-- ere: plus after an alternation --
s/a|+b//
-- ere: anchors in a group --
s/(^a|b$)//
-- ere: unclosed group --
s/(a/x/
-- ere: unmatched group close --
s/a)/x/
-- ere: escaped parentheses --
s/\(a\)//
-- ere: empty group --
s/()//
-- ere: empty alternative --
s/a||b//
-- ere: back-reference --
s/(a)\1//
-- ere: back-reference before its group --
s/\1{2}(a)//
-- ere: back-reference across alternatives --
s/(a)|\1//
-- ere: back-reference past an alternation --
s/((a)|b)\2//
-- ere: back-reference in a later alternative of a group --
s/(a)(b|\1)//
-- ere: back-reference to a repeated group --
s/(a)*\1//
-- ere: replacement reference to a missing group --
s/(a)/\2/
-- ere: GNU escapes --
s/\w*\W+\s?\S{2}//
-- ere: address with an interval --
/a{1}/p
